decision_conditions: <p>The proposed setback of the front elevation together with a semi-enclosed front forecourt is not characteristic of the streetscene. This is exacerbated by its excessive depth in parts, which would alter the way the commercial unit is viewed and accessed in its prominent position on a busy main road with high footfall, dominating the front elevation and setting an unwanted precedent. Equally the loss of Class E floorspace in the major Walthamstow centre location would not be outweighed by the provision of high-quality architectural design. Therefore by virtue of its poor overall visual amenity value and awkward relationship with the host building, the proposal is considered harmful to the character and appearance of nos. 172 and 174 Hoe Street. Additionally the proposed plans, most specifically the front elevation drawings and ground levels, are considered to provide an inaccurate representation of the application site, which does not allow for a full and accurate assessment of its design and appearance within the streetscene. This is contrary to the design objectives of Policy 53 of the adopted Waltham Forest Local Plan LP1 (2024) and the Shop Front Design Supplementary Planning Document (2016).</p>
description: Installation of new shopfront and construction of a single storey rear infill extension to facilitate the amalgamation of 172 and 174 Hoe Street at ground floor level.
